question: Which Pakistani female cricketer was inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sana Mir**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sana Mir**, a former captain of the Pakistan women's cricket team, was inducted into the **ICC Hall of Fame** in **June 2025**. This is a prestigious recognition of her contributions to cricket at the global level.
 
• She is widely acknowledged as one of the **greatest female cricketers** to emerge from Pakistan. Her leadership and performances have significantly shaped the growth of women's cricket in her country.
 
• Sana Mir has played an instrumental role in **leading Pakistan** to numerous achievements, including their first-ever **gold medals** in cricket at the Asian Games in **2010** and **2014**.
 
• In her illustrious career, she represented Pakistan in **120 ODIs** and **106 T20Is**, taking a total of 151 wickets in ODIs and 89 wickets in T20Is, alongside scoring crucial runs.
 
• Sana Mir retired from international cricket in **April 2020**, leaving behind a legacy that inspired many young girls in Pakistan to take up the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **ICC Hall of Fame:**

 
 
• The **ICC Hall of Fame** was established in **2009** by the International Cricket Council (ICC) to honor legendary cricketers for their exceptional contributions to the game.
 
• Inductees are selected based on their **achievements, impact, and influence** on cricket over their careers.
 
• Previous inductees include legends such as **Sir Donald Bradman**, **Muttiah Muralitharan**, and **Jacques Kallis**.
 
 
 
• **Achievements of Sana Mir:**
 
 
• Sana Mir was the **first Pakistani woman** to take 100 wickets in ODIs, making her one of the top bowlers in women’s cricket.
 
• She was ranked as the **number one ODI bowler** in the ICC Women’s Rankings in **October 2018**.
 
• Under her captaincy, Pakistan won their **first-ever ODI series** against the West Indies in **2015**.
 
 
 
• **Other Options Explained:**
 
 
• **Diana Baig:** A talented Pakistani cricketer known for her pace bowling, but she has not been inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame.
 
• **Nida Dar:** A renowned all-rounder nicknamed "Lady Boom Boom," she is one of Pakistan’s best players but has not received this honor yet.
 
• **Bismah Maroof:** The current captain of the Pakistan women’s cricket team, known for her batting prowess, but she has not been inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Sana Mir’s Induction:**
 
 
• Sana Mir’s recognition in the ICC Hall of Fame brings international attention to **women’s cricket in Pakistan**.
 
• It serves as an inspiration for young female cricketers in Pakistan and around the world to pursue the sport professionally.
 
• Her inclusion highlights the growing importance of **gender inclusivity** in global cricket.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The ICC Hall of Fame is a significant platform to honor players who have made exemplary contributions to the game.
 
• Sana Mir is a role model for aspiring cricketers, especially in countries where women’s sports face social and cultural barriers.
 
• Her achievements demonstrate the potential of women in cricket and emphasize the need for equal opportunities in sports globally.
 
• This milestone coincides with the increasing focus on promoting **women’s cricket** by the ICC and cricket boards worldwide.
